main_comparison_protocol.continuous_auc_score: raw predicted heat flux W/m2; pooled source-day labels differ in threshold; supplementary ranking metric
main_comparison_protocol.q100_definition: minimum measured heat flux level from which every evaluated chunk at that and all higher measured levels is predicted positive; no interpolation; unavailable if no level satisfies this
main_comparison_protocol.selection_objective: clean training-OOF MSE; q100 is an evaluation endpoint, not the fitted objective
main_comparison_protocol.comparison_rule: same chunk identities and targets; same clean-fitted models and weights across noise; no selection from outer results
main_comparison_protocol.uncertainty_scope: paired descriptive results on reused known recordings; seeds and artificial noise levels are not independent experiments
main_comparison_protocol.acceptance_rule: complete configured outputs, splits, epochs, weight constraints and restored predictions; performance improvements are observations, not pass/fail criteria
